value.rationale: Bispectral reconstruction from known nonzero Fourier support is natural in harmonic invariants. The canonical Paley half-band has an unexpected unique mid-size positive-dimensional ambiguity at p=13, and the theorem proves that all p≥17 have no continuous ambiguity. The exact threshold holds uniformly for every prime and separates local from global recovery, with direct consequences for identifiability and degeneracy of phase reconstruction.
